answer: A claimant pings three internet exchange points and the three round-trip times triangulate its region, since each exchange sits at a different distance and the combination is hard to fake. A reef of one fast ping proves nothing, so the verifier repeats the measurement over an hour and demands a stable triangle; the crystal clarity of the profile comes from the repeated samples, and a basalt solid fact remains: a farm in another region cannot reproduce the latency triangle.
